column1: # Pinned upstream public data dependencies, fetched by scripts/fetch-data.sh.
# These are living datasets this project both consumes and contributes back to,
# so they are fetched into gitignored data/ subdirectories rather than committed
# or vendored as git submodules. Each is checked out at the commit pinned below
# so that stale-block analysis stays reproducible: the pins should
# be the upstream state the committed results/ were generated against. Bump a
# pin with `just upstream-update <key>` and commit the resulting manifest diff.
# Override the stale-blocks destination with STALE_BLOCKS_DIR. fetch-data.sh
# will not disturb a clone that is on a branch or dirty.
